title: Accept TSO (DEC-0012) and record raft-rs as the Raft library
rationale: PO approved proceeding on the TASK-0003/0009 design drafts on 2026-10-07. design/transactions.md recommends the TSO; design/raft-ranges.md §4 recommends raft-rs for multi-Raft with per-store batched fsync.

data.title: raft-rs as the Raft implementation
data.context: TASK-0003 compared tikv/raft-rs with openraft. DS-CORE runs thousands of Raft groups per store (multi-Raft) and must fsync before ack (REQ-0016).
data.decision: Use raft-rs (core state machine only). One event loop per store drains Ready from all groups, writes their entries in one RocksDB WriteBatch with sync=true, and only then sends messages and advances the groups. Joint consensus via ConfChangeV2 and learners for catch-up and analytics replicas.
